title: Implement temporary alias and avatar onboarding with an explicit picker
prompt: Read README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/PILOT100_BACKLOG.md and the exact referenced imported design sections before editing. RULES-SPEC-v1.md is canonical for production mechanics: six-node Repair/Sabotage tracks, one-person crew votes, Route/Gate operations, deterministic powers and silent spectators. SCREEN-FLOW prototype 5/5 scores and hardcoded transitions are UX references only. Preserve historical T01–T10 APIs/tests; implement the new view version in new game-v1 modules instead of silently changing legacy five-mark boards or command parsers. Use black/charcoal/neutral-frost chrome and full-colour approved expressive content through semantic asset keys. Modal-first means the complete game background is uniformly blur/dim/desaturated and inert; the fixed platform banner dock remains mounted outside that game viewport. No visible accounts/login, telemetry, credentials, live Firebase, ad SDK or unreviewed asset downloads. Keep local presentation distinct from authority: clients display server/solo-engine phases and deadlines, never compute secret outcomes, choose timeout targets, advance multiplayer on a local clock or reveal another alignment. Use injected semantic media/ad/purchase ports; no direct SDK playback or billing calls from UI. Edit only ownership, use original fixtures, run scoped tests/lint/typecheck and npm run check. DOM tests use jsdom, explicit afterEach(cleanup), Vitest and current Testing Library. Report results and contract changes; do not commit, push, open PRs, deploy or spend on providers. Implement the minimalist Alias + avatar step: suggested editable alias, approved avatar, Tap to change selector and a primary continue action. Avatar picker is a blocking neutral glass popup with full-colour approved options, not a reroll and never a cause to change the alias. Duplicate aliases remain valid; distinguish them with avatar, never forced numeric suffixes. Persist only a versioned non-identifying alias/avatar preference through injected storage. No permanent identity or auth token. Keep only back-in-safe-area in visible chrome; input/control accessible labels remain available without extra explanatory body copy.
acceptance: Suggested/editable aliases and avatar choice remain stable across unrelated rerenders; duplicates are accepted without suffix mutation.
Tap to change opens an accessible blocking picker; selecting/canceling changes only the intended avatar preference.
Local preference roundtrip stores only allowed alias/avatar keys and handles corrupt data/storage failure without blocking entry.
Screen body remains minimal per source, keyboard access and Unicode alias validation follow the reviewed profile contract.
designSections: SCREEN-FLOW: 2. Alias + avatar; VISUAL-SYSTEM: Avatar picker
